questions.question: Q: Name the five physical skills a dancer needs for performance.

points.text: Flexibility, strength, stamina, coordination and balance.

questions.question: Q: Why is flexibility important for a dancer?

points.text: Flexibility increases the range of movement at joints, allowing dancers to create extended lines, achieve required shapes and reduce the risk of injury.

questions.question: Q: How does stamina affect dance performance quality?

points.text: Stamina allows the dancer to maintain energy, technique and expression throughout the entire performance without deterioration.

questions.question: Q: Explain the relationship between strength and balance in dance.

points.text: Core and leg strength support the ability to hold stable positions and control weight shifts, which are essential for maintaining balance in static and moving actions.

questions.question: Q: Why must physical skills be developed together rather than in isolation?

points.text: Physical skills are interdependent — for example, coordination relies on balance, and balance relies on strength. Developing only one skill limits overall performance quality.
